verdict.rationale: A single community benchmark shows Ollama running 4-bit quantized variants (q4_K_M and int4) with `ollama run`, so the product does serve integer-quantized models. Nothing else in the pack covers quantization, and no first-party docs describe quantization formats or memory savings. missing for 10: first-party documentation of quantization support, evidence of very low-bit (2-3 bit) formats, evidence of 8-bit formats, documented memory-footprint reduction, a way to select or create quantization levels.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision

citations.quote: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
